enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Present Continuous para descrever ações que estão ocorrendo no momento, situações temporárias, eventos em progresso e tendências. Também apresenta vocabulário relacionado à aposentadoria e ao varejo, com exemplos claros e exercícios de prática.
mainTopics: Vocabulário relacionado a aposentadoria e tendências
Construção de perguntas no Present Continuous

vocabulary.definition: Used to describe something that is happening increasingly over time.
examples: The weather is becoming more and more unpredictable.
More and more people are working remotely.

vocabulary.definition: No longer working, usually because of age.
examples: My father is retired and loves gardening.

vocabulary.definition: The act of stopping work permanently, usually due to age.
examples: She is planning her retirement for next year.

vocabulary.definition: To stop working permanently, usually because of age.
examples: He will retire at the age of 65.

vocabulary.definition: The sale of goods to the public in small quantities for personal use.
examples: The company is a leader in the retail sector.

grammar.explanation: The Present Continuous is used to describe actions happening at the moment of speaking, temporary situations, ongoing events, and trends.
rules: Formed with the verb 'to be' (am/is/are) + the present participle (-ing form) of the main verb.
Use it for actions happening now (e.g., I am studying English now).
Use it for temporary actions (e.g., We are living with my mother for now).
Use it for trends or changes in progress (e.g., The weather is becoming more and more unpredictable).
examples: We’re living with my mother because we’re waiting for the keys to the new apartment.
I’m finishing a project with a big retail company.
The weather is becoming more and more unpredictable.
commonMistakes: Using the base form instead of the -ing form (e.g., 'I am work' instead of 'I am working').
Forgetting to include the verb 'to be' (e.g., 'I working' instead of 'I am working').

practiceQuestions.question: Form a sentence: Liam / save / money / because he wants to buy a car.
practiceQuestions.answer: Liam is saving money because he wants to buy a car.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Present Continuous is used here to describe an action that is happening around now.

practiceQuestions.question: Make a question: why / Liam / save / money?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Questions in Present Continuous are formed with 'to be' + subject + verb-ing.

practiceQuestions.question: Is the following sentence correct? 'He are working on a project.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The verb 'to be' must agree with the subject; it should be 'He is working on a project.'

culturalNotes: In English-speaking cultures, retirement is often a time when people pursue hobbies, travel, or spend more time with family.
Retail is a significant industry in many English-speaking countries and includes roles like salesperson, cashier, or manager.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences in the Present Continuous by describing what you or others are doing at the moment.
Use flashcards to memorize vocabulary and include example sentences to reinforce usage.
Listen to conversations or watch videos in English where people use the Present Continuous to describe actions.
originalExamples: The little girl is having ice cream with her older sister. (A menina está tomando sorvete com sua irmã mais velha.)
Liam is saving money because he wants to buy a car. (Liam está economizando dinheiro porque ele quer comprar um carro.)
You aren’t listening to me. (Você não está me ouvindo.)
My parents are looking for a new apartment. (Meus pais estão procurando um novo apartamento.)
The victim isn’t cooperating with the police. (A vítima não está cooperando com a polícia.)
Lucas and I are planning a trip to Japan. (Lucas e eu estamos planejando uma viagem ao Japão.)
I’m cooking fish for dinner. (Eu estou cozinhando peixe para o jantar.)
The water is boiling. You can put the pasta now. (A água está fervendo. Você pode colocar o macarrão agora.)
Henry isn’t training because he has health problems. (Henry não está treinando porque ele tem problemas de saúde.)
It isn’t raining now. We can go to the park. (Não está chovendo agora. Podemos ir ao parque.)
Are you crying? (Você está chorando?)
Is your father recovering well after the operation? (Seu pai está se recuperando bem após a operação?)
Are the engineers trying to find a solution? (Os engenheiros estão tentando encontrar uma solução?)
Is the baby sleeping? (O bebê está dormindo?)
Are we doing the right thing? (Estamos fazendo a coisa certa?)
Is William studying for his exams? (William está estudando para os exames?)
Are you eating my pizza? (Você está comendo minha pizza?)
Is the client paying by credit card? (O cliente está pagando com cartão de crédito?)
Are your friends winning the match? (Seus amigos estão vencendo a partida?)
Is Tom running in the race? (Tom está correndo na corrida?)
Is Barcelona winning the game? (O Barcelona está ganhando o jogo?)
